{{Quote|No, it's not made from Quor'sav, so don't get any funny ideas.|Part of the description of the dish at Dex's|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Quor'sav-fried steak''' was a type of [[Steak/Legends|steak]] consisting of a large [[Nerf steak/Legends|Nerf steak]] that was coated in seasoned [[pom seed flour]] and then pan-grilled. The recipe for the meal originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uaua/Legends|Uaua]],<ref name="DaD" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE III 65">{{CSWECite|III|65|Quor'sav}}</ref> Quor'sav-fried steak was served on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as part of the breakfast menu at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], where it cost 12.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner of Dex's, served the steak with [[white dwarf gravy]], a side dish, and two [[gartro]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] made to order, describing it as mouth-watering and delicious. The dish was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Quor'sav-fried steak was first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the style of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DaD" />
